name: Self-Update Mechanism
description: Enable projects using FADE to update their local installation and templates to the latest version from the FADE repository. Solves the bootstrap problem where the framework that maintains context can't update itself.

userStories.title: Update FADE CLI to latest version
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE in my project, I want to run `fade update` so that I get the latest CLI commands and features without manually copying files from the FADE repo.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade update` command exists and is documented in `fade help`
Command fetches latest fade script from GitHub (themitchelli/fade)
Updates the fade executable in place (or wherever it's installed)
Shows version before and after update
Handles network errors gracefully with clear error message
Works on macOS (iMac) and Linux (Raspberry Pi)

userStories.title: Update prompt.md to latest template
userStories.description: As a developer using FADE, I want `fade update` to also refresh my project's prompt.md so that I get the latest execution protocol, git conventions, and spike handling without losing my project-specific customizations.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade update` checks if prompt.md differs from latest template
If different, shows diff summary and asks for confirmation before updating
Backs up existing prompt.md to prompt.md.bak before overwriting
prompt.md is replaced with latest template from FADE repo
User can skip prompt.md update with `fade update --cli-only` flag

userStories.title: Check for updates without applying
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to check if updates are available without actually applying them, so I can decide when to update.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade update --check` shows current version vs latest available
Lists what would be updated (CLI, prompt.md, etc.)
Exit code 0 if up-to-date, exit code 1 if updates available (useful for scripting)

userStories.title: Version tracking
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to know what version of FADE I'm running so I can tell if I need to update.
acceptanceCriteria: `fade --version` or `fade version` shows current installed version
Version is stored in the fade script itself or a companion file
FADE repo has a VERSION file or similar as source of truth

technicalNotes.implementation: curl/wget to fetch files, simple bash comparison for versions
considerations: Must work without npm/pip - pure bash solution
Handle case where fade is installed globally vs locally
Consider checksum verification for security (future enhancement)
prompt.md template location in repo needs to be stable
